AttributeList.Text: Alarm display mapping only. This block does not trip equipment or reset faults.
Copy "Sys".Alm_EStop to Common bit 0. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: Release E-STOP and RESET. Reference: C01.
Display alarm: E-STOP active: reset required
Copy "Scrubber_DB".Cause_PSH to Common bit 1. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET with all scrubber trip causes healthy. Reference: C03 / C06a.
Display alarm: Scrubber high pressure: reset required
Copy "Scrubber_DB".Cause_LSHH to Common bit 2. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET with all scrubber trip causes healthy. Reference: C05 / C06a.
Display alarm: Scrubber very high level: reset required
Copy "Scrubber_DB".Cause_PwrUp to Common bit 3. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET with all scrubber trip causes healthy. Reference: S-01 / C06a.
Display alarm: Scrubber waiting for first RESET
Copy "Scrubber_DB".Alm_LSH to Common bit 4. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: Automatically when level returns. Reference: C04.
Display alarm: Scrubber high level (LSH-102)
Copy "Sys".Alm_ParRejected to Common bit 5. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: STOP both; check range; RESET clears alarm. Reference: R-11 / 0009.
Display alarm: Setting rejected
Copy "Scrubber_DB".F_DrainTO to Common bit 6. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET (drain follows level again). Reference: C04a.
Display alarm: Scrubber drain time limit reached
Copy "Scrubber_DB".F_LshFault to Common bit 7. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after the contradictory level-input combination is gone. Reference: C04b.
Display alarm: Scrubber level switch disagreement
Copy "BR01_DB".F_EStop to BR01 bit 0. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear; START to run. Reference: C01.
Display alarm: BR01 E-STOP trip saved
Copy "BR01_DB".F_TC to BR01 bit 1. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after repair. Reference: C07d.
Display alarm: BR01 temperature input fault
Copy "BR01_DB".F_Lockout to BR01 bit 2. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after burner control box lockout cleared. Reference: C07e.
Display alarm: BR01 burner lockout
Copy "BR01_DB".F_NoStart to BR01 bit 3. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear. Reference: C07f.
Display alarm: BR01 RUN not received in time
Copy "BR01_DB".F_RunLost to BR01 bit 4. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear. Reference: C07g.
Display alarm: BR01 RUN input lost
Copy "BR01_DB".F_RunWrong to BR01 bit 5. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET with RUN off and fault causes clear. Reference: R-09.
Display alarm: BR01 RUN without request
Copy !"BR01_DB".LevelOK to BR01 bit 6. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: Automatically when level returns. Reference: C07a.
Display alarm: TK01 level too low for BR01
Copy "BR01_DB".F_Scrubber to BR01 bit 7. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after scrubber trip clears; START to run. Reference: C03 / C05 / R-13.
Display alarm: BR01 stopped by scrubber trip
Copy "BR02_DB".F_EStop to BR02 bit 0. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear; START to run. Reference: C01.
Display alarm: BR02 E-STOP trip saved
Copy "BR02_DB".F_TC to BR02 bit 1. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after repair. Reference: C08d.
Display alarm: BR02 temperature input fault
Copy "BR02_DB".F_Lockout to BR02 bit 2. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after burner control box lockout cleared. Reference: C08e.
Display alarm: BR02 burner lockout
Copy "BR02_DB".F_NoStart to BR02 bit 3. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear. Reference: C08f.
Display alarm: BR02 RUN not received in time
Copy "BR02_DB".F_RunLost to BR02 bit 4. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after fault causes clear. Reference: C08g.
Display alarm: BR02 RUN input lost
Copy "BR02_DB".F_RunWrong to BR02 bit 5. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET with RUN off and fault causes clear. Reference: R-09.
Display alarm: BR02 RUN without request
Copy !"BR02_DB".LevelOK to BR02 bit 6. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: Automatically when level returns. Reference: C08a.
Display alarm: TK02 level too low for BR02
Copy "BR02_DB".F_Scrubber to BR02 bit 7. Bit value 1 displays this alarm. Clears: RESET after scrubber trip clears; START to run. Reference: C03 / C05 / R-13.
Display alarm: BR02 stopped by scrubber trip
